inference_contract.input: BGR uint8 RGB camera image; Ultralytics performs centered letterbox, BGR-to-RGB, BCHW conversion, and 0-to-1 scaling
inference_contract.box_convention: original-image pixel xyxy after Ultralytics postprocessing
inference_contract.depth_role: post-detection distance estimation only; depth is not a neural-network input
inference_contract.depth_estimator: 15 percent inset then full-box fallback; minimum 20 valid pixels; foreground-biased 35th percentile
